ouvir várias opiniões e associar cada item à categoria certa, mesmo com sinônimos e mudanças de ideia.
resolver exercício de matching sem confundir falantes.
Dê sua opinião em 1 frase usando palavras de avaliação:
your city's public transport · online shopping · your last holiday · the IELTS so far
It's well organised · It's overrated · It's good value for money · It's a bit disappointing · It's surprisingly…
cite 2 tipos de distrator de múltipla escolha.
worth the money · reasonably priced · you get a lot for what you pay
packed · hard to find a seat · queues everywhere
not as good as I expected · let me down · overrated
easy to get to · right on the doorstep · saves time
great for kids · children loved it
could be better · there's room for improvement
As for… · When it comes to… · Moving on to… · The second option… · My colleague thinks…, but I…
As for the museum, it was overrated, but the market was good value for money.

questions.questionText: “It let me down” means it was…
“It's right on the doorstep” means it is…
There were ______ everywhere; we waited for an hour. (filas)

And Pine Hill… well, the location was handy, right next to the station, but the showers were old and the staff weren't very helpful — they really need to sort that out.”

explanations.B: “they really need to sort that out”.

questions.questionText: In matching tasks, the categories always appear in the same order as the audio.

explanations.general: Falso: os itens seguem a ordem; as categorias não.

content.text: What does each student say about the following modules? Choose FIVE answers from the list (A–G). Some letters will not be used.
1 Statistics · 2 Urban History · 3 Marketing · 4 Environmental Law · 5 Creative Writing
So, which modules would you recommend for next year?
Well, Statistics — everyone says it's terrifying, but honestly, I found it fine. Once you get the basics, it's quite manageable.
Oh, good. What about Urban History?
Professor Carter teaches it, and she's amazing. She made me want to become a historian! Every lecture felt like a story.
And Marketing? My brother said it's useful for getting a job.
Maybe, but it was a mess this year. Rooms changed every week, and half the time the slides weren't online.
Interesting topic, but the reading list is enormous. We had two essays and a presentation every month — I barely slept.
I loved it. It's all workshops in small groups, so I made loads of friends there — some of my best friends now.
para cada resposta, diga a paráfrase que ouviu. Por que
